content.comment_body: Hello, I purchased two [product_name][article_no]. Both connect via Ethernet without issue. One device works as expected, allowing transfers and updates, and prompts for a password as usual. The other connects but does not request a password, and I am unable to transfer anything. I receive error messages, such as "the connected device does not support...", "Failed to read firmware", and "function not available". I am able to ping the device but cannot perform any further actions. Using [product_name] [version_no]. Any suggestions or assistance would be appreciated.

Are the error messages you mentioned occurring separately during different connection attempts? Which version or hardware revision (FS: XX) do your two [product_name] devices have? Are they the same or different versions? Also, what specific hardware configuration have you selected in your projects?
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread with the subject: No transfer between two new [product_name] [article_no]. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering inconsistent performance between two identical [product_name] devices. Although both connect to the network, only one permits programming and firmware access, while the other responds to pings but fails to allow operational tasks with unclear error messages. This situation causes confusion about device condition, compatibility with the used software version, or hardware setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect both [product_name] devices to be equally available for software programming and firmware operations over Ethernet using the same application and workflow.
